description: Mandviwalla Mauser Plastic Industries Limited is a Karachi-based plastics manufacturer incorporated in 1988, renamed after signing a technical know-how agreement with Mauser Werke GmbH of Germany. Its Port Qasim project has two units: a computerised injection-moulding plant making automotive, textile, household and poultry-industry items, and a blow-moulding unit making plastic drums. The company describes itself as the only manufacturer of plastic barrels of up to 210 litres capacity.
headOffice: Mandviwalla Building, Old Queens Road, Karachi-74000
